title: What Ocean Memorial Parks Is
definition: Ocean Memorial Parks: memorial reefs and parks honoring the departed.
description:
Ocean Memorial Parks is memorial reefs and parks honoring the departed. It sits squarely in Future Oceans & Marine Civilization, the frontier where reef memorials science becomes park logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are visitor boats-scale. Societies that master park hulls early will shape eco burials practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why reef memorials programs worldwide now treat Ocean Memorial Parks as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Ocean Memorial Parks needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Ocean Memorial Parks
title: Real Research Today: Ocean Memorial Parks
definition: Today's documented research behind Ocean Memorial Parks.
description:
The road to Ocean Memorial Parks is already being paved. The International Seabed Authority regulates deep-sea mineral exploration in international waters. Ocean alkalinity enhancement trials are testing carbon removal by adding alkaline minerals to seawater.

The Schmidt Ocean Institute's research vessel Falkor streams deep-sea exploration live to the public. Together these programs form the reef memorials foundation that Ocean Memorial Parks will build on — the park logistics results, the eco burials methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as park logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed reef memorials demonstrations, park logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting eco burials uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Ocean Memorial Parks
definition: Estimates Ocean Memorial Parks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Ocean Memorial Parks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a park hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Ocean Memorial Parks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Ocean Memorial Parks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Ocean Memorial Parks — memorial reefs and parks honoring the departed.

Phase 1 — Prove (reef memorials): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (park logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (eco burials): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (visitor boats): park hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and coastal seas-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
